dict.name: star_fig1
dict.title: STAR Fig. 1: one occupancy sensor with three doorways and one beam

provenance.source: J. Yu, S. M. LaValle, WAFR 2010 (STAR 68), Fig. 1 (p. 394)
provenance.regions: free components L (doorways a and b) and Rt (doorway c, the space right of the beam and the unlabelled room, which is not in C_p); read off a 600-dpi render (docs/notes/paper-examples-star.md section 2)
provenance.names: the paper names only the doorways a, b, c; the vertex names o, b, bl, br are ours and the beam side order is arbitrary (no original counterpart)

dict.name: star_fig2
dict.title: STAR Fig. 2 (= ICRA Fig. 1): three rooms, two beams, two occupancy sensors

provenance.source: J. Yu, S. M. LaValle, WAFR 2010 (STAR 68), Fig. 2 (p. 396), V on p. 397, Fig. 3(a)-(b) (p. 397)
provenance.regions: free components R1-R4 as labelled in STAR Fig. 2; read off a 600-dpi render and checked against Fig. 3(b) (docs/notes/paper-examples-star.md section 2)
provenance.edges: edge list and order of the original DetectiveGame.getBasicGame() (arc-l/cyber-detective@55f57f8) minus its virtual SV-A edge; as a set equal to STAR Fig. 3(a)
provenance.beam_sides: side order and vertex_order (creation order, b2l before b2r) as in DetectiveGame.getBasicGame(); both matter only for compat="original"
